name: Coffee Love
source:
Even as a child you were very enthusiastic about your grandparents' café.
The smell, the taste... everything seemed so magical.
So after you graduate, you decide to move back to their neighborhood to help out in the cafe and bring some new energy in it.
You bump into old familiar faces and reminisce.
Which also leads to some confusing feelings coming up inside you.

[From [url=https://kokiristudios.itch.io/coffee-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你还是个孩子的时候，你就对祖父母的咖啡馆非常热情。
气味、味道……一切都显得那么神奇。
因此，毕业后，你决定搬回他们的社区，在咖啡馆帮忙，并为其带来一些新的活力。
你会遇到熟悉的老面孔并回忆起来。
这也会导致你内心产生一些令人困惑的感觉。

[来自[url=https://kokiristudios.itch.io/coffee-love]itch.io[/url]]
